<noscript>
  <h1>Kamp's expressive completeness theorem (1968)</h1>
  <p>Linear Temporal Logic with Until and Since has the exact expressive power of First-Order Logic FO[<] over the natural numbers. Gabbay's separation property eliminates nested temporal interferences, reducing initial validity to pure-future LTL.</p>
</noscript>
